center.doc: The center of the icon is placed closest to the anchor.

left.doc: The left side of the icon is placed closest to the anchor.

icon-anchor.doc: Part of the icon placed closest to the anchor.

icon-size.units: factor of the original icon size
icon-size.doc: Scales the original size of the icon by the provided factor. The new pixel size of the image will be the original pixel size multiplied by `icon-size`. 1 is the original size; 3 triples the size of the image.

symbol-sort-key.doc: Sorts features in ascending order based on this value. Features with lower sort keys are drawn and placed first. When `icon-allow-overlap` or `text-allow-overlap` is `false`, features with a lower sort key will have priority during placement. When `icon-allow-overlap` or `text-allow-overlap` is set to `true`, features with a higher sort key will overlap over features with a lower sort key.

text-halo-width.doc: Distance of halo to the font outline. Max text halo width is 1/4 of the font-size.

text-color.doc: The color with which the text will be drawn.
